source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Common Types of Cyberattacks (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Cyber threats ki mukhtalif qismein hain. Virus infected (bimar) files ke zariye phailta hai aur data kharab ya delete kar sakta hai. Phishing jaali emails ya websites ke zariye logon ko dhoka de kar un se passwords ya zaati tafseel lene ki koshish karti hai. Ransomware data ko lock kar deta hai aur kholne ke liye paisa (payment) mangta hai, jab ke spyware chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai. Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) hamle websites par itna bojh (traffic) dalte hain ke woh crash ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch cards: Virus (mutasira files se phail kar data kharab), Phishing (jaali email ya website se password ki chori), Ransomware (data band, paisay ki maang), Spyware (chupke se maloomat jama), DDoS (website par itna bojh ke crash). Neeche 'Nuqsan kis ko?': afraad files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte; idaron ko data breach, rukay kaam, bharosa, saakh aur maali nuqsan.
blocks.caption: Cyber hamlon ki paanch qismein aur un ka nuqsan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).
Cyberattacks ki qismein
rows: Infected files se phailta hai; data kharab ya delete
Fake emails ya websites se password ya zaati maloomat ka dhoka
Data lock kar ke kholne ke paise mangta hai
Chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta hai
Website par itni requests ke woh crash ho jaye

blocks.prompt: Aap ki files achanak lock ho jati hain aur screen par paise mange jate hain. Yeh kaun sa hamla hai? Aur DDoS kya karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ransomware. DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) bohat si requests bhej kar website ko overload (zyada bojh) kar ke crash kar deta hai.

items: Virus, phishing, ransomware, spyware aur DDoS aam cyberattacks hain.
